question: What procedure consecrates the body when another liṅga is properly joined?
premises: Another liṅga is to be well joined.
The body is the object of consecration.
The consecration must follow the prescribed rite.
inference: Having properly joined another liṅga, one should consecrate the body according to the rite.
plain_english: Having properly joined another liṅga, one should consecrate the body according to the prescribed rite.
